report:
Breast, left, total mastectomy

The specimen consists of a left total mastectomy specimen (520 g, 190 x 160 x 45 mm) with an overlying skin ellipse (170 x 60 mm) bearing the nipple. Sectioning reveals a firm, grey-white, ill-defined, stellate tumour measuring 28 mm in greatest dimension (28 x 22 x 20 mm) in the upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock, 30 mm from the nipple), 9 mm from the posterior margin. The skin and nipple are unremarkable. A second firm ill-defined area measuring 11 mm is present 25 mm inferior to the main tumour. 14 lymph nodes are identified in the axillary tissue.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total mastectomy
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock, 30 mm from the nipple)
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 28 mm (28 x 22 x 20 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive lobular carcinoma, classic
- Tumour focality: Multiple foci of invasive carcinoma (two foci, 28 mm and
  11 mm)
- Histologic grade: Grade 2 (scores of 6 or 7); total score 6
- Tubule formation: Score 3
- Nuclear pleomorphism: Score 2
- Mitotic rate: Score 1
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an invasive lobular carcinoma, Nottingham grade 2 (tubule
  formation 3, nuclear pleomorphism 2, mitotic count 1; total 6), measuring
  28 mm in greatest dimension as multiple foci (two foci, 28 mm and 11 mm). The
  tumour cells are small, discohesive and monomorphic, with round to notched
  ovoid nuclei and scant cytoplasm occasionally containing an intracytoplasmic
  lumen, and infiltrate singly and in single files and cords, in places
  encircling benign ducts in a targetoid pattern; a desmoplastic reaction is
  inconspicuous. Lymphovascular invasion is present. The nipple and skin are not
  involved. The background breast shows lobular carcinoma in situ, classic.
  E-cadherin is negative in the tumour cells.
- Tumour extension: Confined to the breast parenchyma
  - Nipple: Present and not involved
  - Skin: Present and not involved
  - Skin satellite foci: Not identified
  - Skeletal muscle: Not present in specimen
- Lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Present
- Dermal lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Breast treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Ductal carcinoma in situ: Not identified
- Additional lesions: Lobular carcinoma in situ, classic
- Microcalcifications: Not identified

Ancillary studies
- Biomarker studies: Reported on the prior core biopsy (S26-01234): ER positive
  (100%, strong), PR positive (90%, strong), HER2 negative (score 0), Ki-67 8%

Margins (invasive carcinoma)
- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: 9 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm

Regional lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: Axillary dissection
- Number of lymph nodes examined: 14
- Number of lymph nodes with macrometastasis (>2 mm): 4
- Number of lymph nodes with micrometastasis (> 0.2 mm to 2 mm and/or >
  200 cells): 0
- Number of lymph nodes with isolated tumour cells (0.2 mm or less and 200 cells
  or fewer): 0
- Size of largest metastatic deposit: 12 mm (level I)
- Extranodal extension: Present (3 mm)

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT2(m) pN2a
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIIA

Additional findings
- None
